feedback.delta: Do not treat physical REENTERED as semantic COMPLETE unless exact terminal DONE receipt is present and its causal/provenance support chain verifies.

Typed effect terminalization needs explicit AttemptIdentity, VerifiedOutcomeIdentity, ExecutionGeneration, GWTUseReceipt, CausalCreditReceipt, AdmittedDelta|ExplicitNoLearning, SupportSnapshotReceipt and DoneReceipt; no free-text authority fields.
Receiver addressable/delivered/reconstructed/used/local_effect remain distinct; terminal causal use must bind the exact receiver receipt to the same effect/outcome chain.
Graph edges may accelerate joins/diagnostics but cannot prove terminal causal closure; authoritative rows must revalidate selected graph paths.
Simple V17 and richer V17 remain unresolved alternatives; retain both lineage and falsifiers until target evidence discriminates.
Activation/re-entry recurrence cannot itself grant causal credit or learning authority.
Add relational cross-splice, stale execution generation, crash cutpoint and exact-current terminal receipt cases to direct Frank v0.1 validation.
Crash/restart between verified outcome, support binding, re-entry and DONE must never produce duplicate external effect or false COMPLETE; uncertain provider outcomes reconcile before retry.
Learning/state delta admission must be causally linked to the verified effect outcome; CURRENT semantic-record existence is not sufficient.

shared_invalidators: candidate support IDs accepted only by non-empty text checks
next_interrupt_condition: Any target receipt showing richer V17 accepts cross-spliced support or fails crash/restart invalidates promotion and should interrupt canonical-integration work.
